slides.title: What is Amnesty asking the African Union to do on Ethiopia?

slides.text: In an Oct 2 statement, Amnesty International urged the **AU Peace and Security Council** to **urgently convene an emergency session** on Ethiopia.
Amnesty also called on all relevant authorities to **immediately restore access to communications services**.
It said the AU, **IGAD** and the **UN** must address the entrenched **accountability crisis**. These are Amnesty's views.
The statement does not report a session since. **Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
